newsitem.title: UK: UK's Gardner plans bid for Mackie-paper.
newsitem.headline: UK's Gardner plans bid for Mackie-paper.

text.p: British engineering firm L Gardner Group Plc has been examining the possibility of a bid for Mackie International Group Plc, the Belfast Telegraph newspaper said.
Gardner chairman Mike McDonald, in an interview in the newspaper, said he was interested in acquiring the company.
Mackie shares were suspended in April after the company announced that "certain matters had come to light which may or may not lead to a restatement of the accounts" for 1996.

"I'm not in the know about what is happening regarding the share suspension, but Mackies know I am still interested and I believe there are good opportunities there," the Belfast Telegraph quoted McDonald as saying.
"We could bring in the orders, and I have projects in mind. One in particular could bring in 40 million stg over four or five years."
